name: Human effort per task
what: The hours of people time a task needs from preparation through review, correction and rework.
stage: Any task repeated weekly or more often, where the manual baseline can be measured before the build starts.
lever: He maps the task, times the manual baseline, removes steps first and only then automates what is left.
whereUsed: A 30% cut in manual outreach effort at CampK12 for a 400+ instructor workforce. For the Toronto founder, 20 to 30 hours a month of manual number-checking saved.

name: Output accuracy
what: The share of outputs that are correct and usable on real inputs without a person fixing them.
stage: Before a workflow touches customers, money or data that people rely on.
lever: He tests with real inputs and edge cases, adds validation checks and keeps human review before any consequential action.
whereUsed: Python automation frameworks at Accenture for banking and healthcare clients cut post-deployment defects by 15%.

name: Turnaround time
what: The elapsed time from request to finished output, measured separately from effort.
stage: When people wait on the result, such as outreach, reporting, screening or onboarding.
lever: He runs steps in parallel and removes handoffs that only pass work along.
whereUsed: Nine parallel B2B pipelines, built within 90 days, feed one dashboard tracking 2,314 prospects and $1.47M CAD of pipeline.

name: Adoption without help
what: The share of the intended users who run the workflow on their own without asking its builder for help.
stage: At handoff, and again after the first month of real use.
lever: He writes a one-page operating guide, trains the team on their own tasks and makes the next step obvious at every point.
whereUsed: For the Toronto founder he wrote 9 SOPs so every workflow runs without depending on one person.

name: Cost per run
what: Model and tool spend per completed task, compared with the human effort it replaces.
stage: When volume grows and small per-run costs start to add up.
lever: He uses the smallest model that holds quality, caches repeated steps and trims the input before it is sent.
whereUsed: The tools on the Shipped page cap input size, and the ones that handle people data strip contact details before any text reaches a model.
